title: Hudson Street Library wing registry
description: src/_data/wings.json. One entry per wing (collection). Entry 0 is the default wing (isDefault: true); its file is what unscoped surfaces such as the homepage show. slug = catalog filename = URL prefix = owner of the id block. Validated at build by scripts/utils/catalog.js.

slug.description: URL prefix (/<slug>/) and, for non-default wings, the catalog/<slug>.csv basename.

file.description: CSV path relative to src/_data/. Shares the 37-column schema with every other wing.

isDefault.description: Exactly one wing. Pages with no wing declared show this one; it has no landing page of its own (the homepage is its front door).

live.description: false = block reserved and file seeded, but no landing page is generated and the wing is not linked. Flip to true at go-live.

idBlock.description: [lo, hi] inclusive. Every id in the wing's file must fall inside unless listed in allowLegacyIds. Blocks must not overlap.

allowLegacyIds.description: Rows migrated from another wing that keep their original id (URLs contain ids).

itemPath.description: Item pages publish at /books/... (book wings) or /objects/... (object wings).

classifications.description: Allowed values of the classification column (the form axis) in this wing. Empty = not yet decided.

defaultGrouping.description: collection_grouping (shelf) new rows get when none is given.

intake.description: How adds to this wing are dated. "acquired" (default): the book just arrived, so accession_no = today and cataloged_date is left empty — it belongs on Recently Added. "catalogued": the wing is being built from books already on the shelves, so cataloged_date = today and accession_no stays EMPTY — it belongs on Recently Catalogued. Set per wing; an individual add can still override it after the fact.

intro.description: Landing-page intro, HTML allowed. Written at go-live; de-slop before shipping.

featuredTags.description: Tags surfaced as clusters on the landing page.
